name: Jehovah
overview: The name Jehovah reveals God's self-existence and supreme authority, as seen in Exodus 6:3 where God declares that He was known by this name, distinguishing Himself from the title God Almighty. Jehovah is intimately involved in the lives of His people, providing and protecting them, exemplified by Abraham naming a place Jehovahjireh, meaning 'The Lord will provide' (Genesis 22:14), and Moses naming an altar Jehovahnissi, 'The Lord my banner' (Exodus 17:15). Psalm 83:18 emphasizes that Jehovah alone is the Most High over all the earth, affirming His unmatched sovereignty. This name invites believers to trust in God's provision, leadership, and ultimate reign, grounded in the truth of Scripture.
